description: This file defines the AttachmentsGridManager class, which customizes layout behavior for a RecyclerView displaying attachments in a grid within an Android application.

classes.name: AttachmentsGridManager
classes.description: A custom LinearLayoutManager that adjusts item layout parameters such as width and height for a RecyclerView in the attachments grid.

methods.name: checkLayoutParams
methods.description: Overrides the default method to set specific width and height for each item's layout parameters, ensuring consistent sizing within the grid layout.
